result.markdown: # Foundations of R ![](/images/foundational.png){style="width:200px; background: white; border-radius:5px; border: 5px white solid" fig-align="center"} This section will cover the foundations of R. Understanding these concepts is fundamental to becoming an R user. The pages of this part are: - [Operators](/foundations/operators.qmd): Include `+`, `-`, `*`, and `/`, they allow us to use R like a calculator - [Variables](/foundations/variables.qmd): Allow us to save the output from commands so we can use them in future commands - [Functions](/foundations/functions.qmd): R contains a plethora of __functions__ that perform many different tasks - [Directories](/foundations/directories.qmd): How to change directory/folders and view their content - [Script editor](/foundations/script_editor.qmd): Use of the Rstudio script editor to write, edit, and save cod ein scripts. - [Recap](/foundations/recap.qmd): Recap of definitions with MCQs - [Exercises](/foundations/exercise.qmd): Tasks to gain further practice of the foundations of R ::: {.cell} ::: {.cell-output-display} ```{=html} ``` ::: ::: {.cell-output-display} ```{=html} ``` ::: ::: {.cell-output-display} ```{=html} ``` ::: :::
